prompt: A friend finishes explaining a problem. Which reply shows active listening best?

options.text: Summarising what they said and checking you understood it
Changing the subject to something cheerful
Waiting silently until they stop talking, then giving your verdict

explanation: Active listening involves reflecting back what the speaker said — a short summary or paraphrase — and checking it matches what they meant. It confirms understanding before advice, and makes the speaker feel heard.
